title: Lior and the Hymn
author: Odile Dunmore
blurb: Lior Dunmore, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
